projectNavbar.startProcessConfirmTitle: Start AI processing of the documents
projectNavbar.startProcessConfirmDescription:
Starting the processing begins the AI-supported formal completeness check of the submitted documents. This process may take several hours. No changes to the project are possible while processing is running.

Note: If another project is currently already being processed by the AI, please start this project only after the ongoing processing has been completed.
